lines.en: Crystal clusters sway on my back.
One step and the soil packs flat.
Originium glows inside my body.
I stand a head above the trees.
The stones on my shoulders knock together.
My huge shadow falls on the wall.
I lift an arm a little.
Dust rises when my foot lands.
The prints I leave are deep.
I stand like a stone hill.
The crystals pulse with light.
I lower my head to rest.
Light shows in the cracks on my body.
The wind keeps going around me.
Stone chips fall from my shoulders.
I breathe slowly.
I hear voices far off.
The grass here is too soft.
I shift my weight a little.

lines.zh: 背上的晶体又长了一点。
lines.en: The crystals on my back grew a little.
You have to look up to see all of me.
I bring my head down over you.
You look tiny inside my shadow.
My hands are all crystal growths.

lines.zh: 你离我这个距离不安全。
lines.en: This distance from me isn't safe.
I crouch down a little.
You carry no originium glow.
My eyes are two chips of originium.
Are you not the least bit afraid?

lines.zh: 你的声音传不到我这里。
lines.en: Your voice barely reaches me.
I tilt my head slowly.
The grass under me is all bent.
Only a few steps separate us.

lines.zh: 我在算什么，你不会知道。
lines.en: You won't know what I'm considering.
I rise up slowly.
You've stepped back a few paces.
A lot of soil has settled on me.
A chunk of originium falls off me.
A crack opened in my crystals.
I stepped back and the ground still shakes.
I've filed that one away.
I slowly turn my body back.
The stone cracking sounded hollow.
This damage is immaterial.
My steps haven't faltered.
That isn't enough for me.
Only originium whets my appetite.
What do you want, holding that up?

lines.zh: 我的食物在更深的地方。
lines.en: My food lies deeper down.
That little originium isn't enough to chew.
What's in your hand is too small.
The colossus bends low to sniff.
I no longer need feeding.
Keep it for yourself, then.
Iron blocks, though, I could swallow.
I slowly look away.
It won't block my path.
I step right over it.
I've little appetite.
Bring something else.
That doesn't smell of originium.
You carry none of that glow.

lines.zh: 我的源石外壳纹丝不动。
lines.en: My originium shell doesn't even flinch.
I didn't stop for a step.

lines.zh: 我身上震下来一些碎石。
lines.en: Loose stones fell off me.
Your hands must be numb.
My foot left a crater.
Don't lean on my crystals.
I managed to stay on my feet.
Your blade struck stone.
I am steady again.
I lower my weight to steady.
I grew out of originium.
I have no need for such things.
Standing side by side is enough.
Two colossi block the wind.
Your crystals shine brighter than mine.
Our steps fall equally heavy.
I'll watch the east for you.
I'm too slow; don't wait for me.
The ground would sink between us.
Then let's just stand together.

lines.zh: 这东西在我掌心里太小。
lines.en: This thing is tiny in my palm.
It crumbled in my palm.
This must be what you dropped.

lines.zh: 一千点血，我走一步地都响。
lines.en: A thousand health — every step of mine booms.
It carries a trace of light.
I set it on my shoulder.
That weight means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我一只手就拎起。
lines.en: I lift this in one hand.
I've turned toward you.
That movement of yours stood out.
I lower my weight and advance.
My stride covers more than yours.

lines.zh: 你的头顶只有我的影子。
lines.en: Only my shadow is over your head.
I've lifted one foot.
I'm slowly closing the distance.
Stones slide off my back.

lines.zh: 你站在哪儿，我早就算出来了。
lines.en: I worked out where you stand long ago.
I start walking toward you.
The ground cracks under me.
The distance keeps shrinking.
I keep track of every step you take.
You're running for the trees.
Those trees won't stop me.
My raised hand blots out the sun.
That wall is too thin for me.
You've still got some road left.
I'm two strides from you.
You were thrown clean off your feet.
That palm pressed down my full weight.
You stopped against a tree.
My fist drove into the ground.
My palm is two of you wide.
You've fallen back several paces.
I raise my arm and pause.
Your armor caved right in.
The crater in the ground is deep.
I rose up out of the earth.
Crystals pushed out of my back.
The ground split beneath me.
I raise my head for the first time.
Light seeps from my cracks.

lines.zh: 周围没有一棵树比我高。
lines.en: No tree here stands as tall as me.
People far off must have seen it.
My breath rattles the air.
Stone chips keep falling off me.
I start to move, slowly.
The fire on my body burns hot.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，震裂了地。
lines.en: I came down hard and split the ground.
Water rises and I grow very heavy.
The blast shook a crystal loose.

lines.zh: 一点小东西扎在我身上。
lines.en: Something small lodged in me.

lines.zh: 那股力量穿过了我的裂缝。
lines.en: That force went through my cracks.
I haven't been replenished in a long time.
Lightning struck my crystals.
There's nothing beneath my feet.
